name: Plaza de la Paz
demographics: Plaza de la Paz serves the affluent Laguna Niguel community in South Orange County, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area consists of well-educated homeowners with household incomes typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+, including many dual-income families with children. Shoppers are drawn to the center's convenient mix of everyday services, health and wellness offerings, and quality dining options that cater to health-conscious, active lifestyles typical of coastal Orange County residents.
description: Plaza de la Paz is a vibrant community shopping center located in the heart of Laguna Niguel, California, serving South Orange County residents since its establishment on La Paz Road. This well-appointed center features over 45 diverse tenants including restaurants, specialty shops, medical professionals, and essential services that have become integral to the daily lives of local residents. Major anchors include Home Depot, Sprouts Farmers Market, and CVS Pharmacy, complemented by popular dining destinations like Chipotle, Blaze Pizza, and Mangia Bene Cucina. The center has cultivated a strong community connection, hosting a weekly Farmers Market every Sunday from 9am to 1pm that draws locals for fresh produce and artisanal goods. With its convenient location, ample parking, and thoughtfully curated tenant mix spanning retail, dining, fitness, and professional services, Plaza de la Paz has established itself as an essential neighborhood gathering place where residents can accomplish their shopping, dining, and wellness needs in one convenient destination.
summary: Plaza de la Paz is a well-established community shopping center in Laguna Niguel featuring over 45 tenants including Home Depot, Sprouts Farmers Market, and diverse dining and service options. The center serves as a neighborhood hub with a popular weekly Farmers Market and convenient mix of retail, restaurants, medical offices, and wellness services.
